svg.title: 日本庭园散步｜原创示意 · 非实景
svg.desc: 池塘、踏石、松树与石灯笼组成的虚构日式庭园。纯属风格化庭园意象，不对应实际景点、现场景观、植物季相、地理布局或可通行路线。
svg.metadata: Original AI-assisted illustration geometry authored for the Mangen project, batch 2026-10-14. Not a photograph or official diagram. Noto Sans CJK SC lettering converted to paths; no embedded font, external resource, raster source, script, or third-party artwork.
